notes_for_editor: Low confidence. Sources are a county and agency page (source 1), the FFLOS index, which marks both Cushing sites as Tower Gone (source 2), and a GeoNames-based map entry (source 3). The map point (31.7674, -94.80688) matches the Loc 2 index position; it is a database listing and does not show whether any structure stands. Loc 1 (31.83592, -94.85356) is also marked gone and is not in this brief; it may need its own record. FFLOS spells the county 'Nacagdoches'; the other sources use 'Nacogdoches', which the story follows. No build date, design, staffing or fire record was found, so the story omits those sections. Recommend a human look before publishing, and a search of primary Texas Forest Service records if the story is to be expanded.
